**Which framework/feature?**
e.g. SvelteKit, SolidStart, Nuxt, Remix, Tauri preset…

**Why?**
Who needs this and what does it unlock?

**Have you checked the extension guide?**
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) documents how templates slot into the
registry. Sketch which parts you would add (framework base, language slices,
package fragments) and whether you plan to submit a PR.

**Additional context**
Any references (official scaffolding docs, config formats).
